To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) The U-Pb ages of zircons from the Vernal Mesa-type monzonite are 1,443±22 m.y. and the Rb-Sr ages of the monzonite are in the range of 1,450±50 m.y. 2) The Vernal Mesa monzonite is a member of an extensive suite of rocks that formed during the Middle Precambrian (1,450-1,500 m. y.). 3)

(a) the U-Pb age obtained for the Vernal Mesa-type monzonite, 1,443± 22 m.y. (1σ), confirms the previously reported Rb-Sr whole-rock age of 1.480± 40 m.y., and (b) the U-PB age is consistent with the age of the Precambrian intrusive activity in the region, 1,450-1,500 m y.
the Vernal Quartz Monzonite has a U-Pb age that confirms its 1,450-1,500 m. y. age, and that the zircon grains from the Vernal Mesa Quartz Monzonite are not metamict.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the origin and evolution of the continental crust.
the study of the geology and geochemistry of the Precambrian Vernal Mesa-type Quartz Monzonite.
the origin of the igneous rocks of the Vernal Mesa-type suite and the age of the Vernal Mesas.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Vernal quartz monzonite was emplaced 1,443 m.y. ago and is 200 m.y., at most, older than the 1,480-m.y. Rb-Sr isochron age reported by others.
the age of the Vernal Mesa-type is 1,450 ± 20 m.y., which agrees with the Rb-Sr whole-rock age.
the Vernal Quartz Monzonite, which has been dated by Rb-Sr and U-Pb methods at 1,443 and 1,480 m.y. respectively, was formed in the interval between 1,450 and 1,500 million years.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Vernal Quartz Monzonite is 1,450 ± 20 m.y. old.
this is an igneous suite of 1,450 m.y. age, and is probably the oldest known igneous suite in the Colorado Plateau.
the Vernal mesa is a large body of Precambrian quartz monzonite that is 1,450 ± 50 m.y. old.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Vernal is not older than 1,450 m.y.; it is younger, not older, than the 1,500-m.y.-old rocks in the Uncompahgre uplift.
the Vernal Quartz Monzonite is not a Mesozoic intrusion, but is instead a Precambrian intrusion, and is thus a much older feature than previously thought.
the U-Pb method of dating zircons is a powerful tool that can be used to date rocks that are not suitable for Rb-Sr dating, and can also be used to refine Rb-Sr ages.
